header.title: Meteors
header.description: Shooting-star field over the child. It adds a decorative layer (`pointer-events: none`) with streaks crossing diagonally, each with its own position, delay, duration, and length. `variant` sets the streak (`trail`, `ember`, `shard`), `reverse` flips the direction, and `count` or `intensity` the amount.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the code they generate.
playground.label: Night

base.title: Basic meteors
base.description: With the defaults (`variant="trail"`, `intensity="md"`, `duration={3200}`), `14` streaks of `1px` in `primary-200` cross at `32deg`. The travel is measured against the layer's width (container units), so every streak crosses the whole field whatever its size. The field fills the whole root, so size, radius, and background go on the root. Since the layer sits above the content, keep the text short or high-contrast.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `trail` is a thin line that fades out. `ember` is thicker, with a `tertiary-400` head and a glow. `shard` is shorter (`55%` of the length) and steeper (`48deg`).

reverse.title: Direction
reverse.description: By default streaks enter from the left and travel right. With `reverse` they enter from the right and travel left.

image.title: On an image
image.description: Meteors overlay any content, such as an image. The layer has `aria-hidden` and `pointer-events: none`, so it doesn't interfere with the alt text or with clicks.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: `color` is the streak color (it fades to transparent). Default `primary-200`. Prefer tokens. With `ember`, the head stays `tertiary-400`.

count.title: Count
count.description: `count` sets the number of streaks and takes priority over `intensity`. The maximum is `48`. Positions and timing are pseudo-random but stable: every instance with the same count draws the same pattern.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: `speed` multiplies the speed: `2` is twice as fast and `0.5` half (clamped to `0.2`–`4`). `duration` is the base cycle at `speed={1}`; each streak takes between `70%` and `140%` of that cycle.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover` the layer is hidden and appears when the pointer enters or something inside gets keyboard focus. With `click`, each click shows or hides it. The streaks restart every time.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` changes the streak opacity (`65%`, `85%`, or `100%` with `sm`, `md`, or `lg`) and, without `count`, how many there are: `8`, `14`, or `22`. It also takes a number from `0` to `1`. Tokens read `--gemfx-intensity-*`, so you can redefine them on an ancestor.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the streaks where they are. `isDisabled` hides the layer and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onMeteors` fires when the field turns on (pointer enter or keyboard focus on the button with `hover`, click with `click`, or mount with `always`) and `outMeteors` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. The button still gets clicks.

texts.body: Hover or Tab to the button to turn the meteors on, and click the button.

header.title: Meteors API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Meteors`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, trigger, and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/meteors` with its `meteors.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (except color) and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus, and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic. --gemfx-meteors-color and --gemfx-meteors-intensity are only written inline when you pass color or intensity, and then they go after style.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the streaks are hidden entirely.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps them. Use it only when the motion is essential.
items.decorative: The layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it isn't announced and doesn't block clicks.
items.focus: With trigger="hover" the meteors also appear when something inside gets keyboard focus (:focus-visible), and onMeteors/outMeteors fire just like with the pointer. With click the root isn't focusable: the keyboard can't turn them on.
items.density: The layer sits above the content (z-index: 2). With a lot of text, lower count or use a low speed so the streaks don't compete with reading.

items.variant: Active variant. `ember` thickens the streak and adds a head and glow; `shard` shortens it and makes it steeper.
items.reverse: Added with `reverse`. Streaks enter from the right.
items.trigger: Active trigger. Sets `cursor: pointer` and hides the layer while it isn't on.
items.on: Added while the field is on with `click`.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses the streaks with `animation-play-state`.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Hides the layer and removes the animation.
items.layer: Decorative layer (`position: absolute`, `inset: 0`, `z-index: 2`, `aria-hidden`, `container-type: size`). Inherits the root's radius and takes its opacity from the intensity.
items.meteor: Each streak: `1px` tall, a gradient to transparent, and its own animation, which crosses the layer along its tilted axis. `top` and timing are inline.
items.surface: Wraps the child (`z-index: 1`). With `asChild`, the class goes on the child itself.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: `color` and `intensity` are only written inline if you pass the prop; otherwise you can redefine them with a class. Per-streak timing is inline on each streak.

items.intensity: Layer intensity: its opacity is `min(100%, intensity + 30%)`. Set by `intensity`; default `var(--gemfx-intensity-md)`.
items.meteor: Delay, duration, and length of each streak. Computed in JS (from `duration`, `speed`, and `delay`) and written inline on each one.
items.trajectory: Streak geometry, defined on `.gemfx-meteors__meteor`: angle (`32deg`), slope (`tan(angle)`, `0.625`), direction (`1` or `-1`), travel (`100cqw` plus two lengths), and gradient direction. `shard` and `reverse` adjust them. If you change the angle, change the slope too so the streak follows its axis.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Meteors reads as defaults. You can redefine them on the root with a class.

items.ember: `ember` head and glow (fallback `#ffa61f`). There's no prop to change it.
items.intensity: Default intensity (fallback `55%`). With `intensity="sm"` or `"lg"` it reads `--gemfx-intensity-sm` and `--gemfx-intensity-lg`.

content.title: Content
content.description: What sits under the meteors and where the effect mounts.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Cycle, speed, and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it shows, how it pauses, and how it turns off.

items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. With void elements like `img` it falls back to the `div`.
items.variant: `trail` is a thin line, `ember` a warm head with a glow, and `shard` a shorter streak.
items.color: Streak color. Prefer a token; default `primary-200`.
items.count: Number of streaks (max `48`). Takes priority over `intensity`.
items.intensity: Streak opacity (`65%`, `85%`, or `100%`) and, without `count`, the number of streaks: `8`, `14`, or `22`.
items.reverse: Streaks enter from the right and travel left.
items.duration: Base cycle at `speed={1}`. Each streak takes between `70%` and `140%`.
items.speed: Speed multiplier, between `0.2` and `4`. `2` is twice as fast.
items.trigger: `always` shows them all the time, `hover` when the pointer enters or something inside gets focus, and `click` toggles them on each click.
items.isActive: Lets the field run. With `false` it hides and `outMeteors` gets `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Hides the field; the child stays interactive. `outMeteors` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Shows the meteors even if the user prefers less motion. Only when essential.
items.onMeteors: Fires when the field turns on: on mount with `always`, on pointer enter or keyboard focus with `hover`, or on click with `click`.
items.outMeteors: Fires when it turns off: on pointer or focus leave, on the next click, when disabled, or on unmount.
items.classNames: Per-part classes: `root`, `surface`, `layer`, and `meteor` (applied to each streak).
items.style: Inline styles for the root. If you pass `color` or `intensity`, their variables are written after it.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
